title: Detailed tent
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ground / grass -->
  <rect x="0" y="78" width="100" height="22" fill="#2e8b57"/>
  <rect x="0" y="78" width="100" height="4" fill="#3cb371"/>

  <!-- tent shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="42" ry="7" fill="#1f6b43"/>

  <!-- back wall of tent (inside) -->
  <polygon points="20,78 50,18 80,78" fill="#d4a017"/>

  <!-- tent body - main front panels -->
  <polygon points="16,78 50,18 48,78" fill="#e8c547"/>
  <polygon points="84,78 50,18 52,78" fill="#c9a227"/>

  <!-- door opening -->
  <polygon points="40,78 50,40 60,78" fill="#7a5c00"/>
  <!-- door interior glow -->
  <polygon points="42,78 50,44 58,78" fill="#b8860b"/>

  <!-- tent ridge line -->
  <line x1="50" y1="18" x2="50" y2="78" stroke="#b8860b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- side seam details -->
  <line x1="28" y1="60" x2="50" y2="18" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="60" x2="50" y2="18" stroke="#a88200" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- lower hem -->
  <line x1="16" y1="78" x2="84" y2="78" stroke="#8b6914" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- tie-down ropes left -->
  <line x1="16" y1="70" x2="6" y2="82" stroke="#e8e8e8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="16" y1="58" x2="4" y2="74" stroke="#e8e8e8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- stake left -->
  <line x1="6" y1="80" x2="4" y2="86" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="4" y1="74" x2="2" y2="84" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- tie-down ropes right -->
  <line x1="84" y1="70" x2="94" y2="82" stroke="#e8e8e8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="84" y1="58" x2="96" y2="74" stroke="#e8e8e8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- stakes right -->
  <line x1="94" y1="80" x2="96" y2="86" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="96" y1="74" x2="98" y2="84" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- center pole top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="17" r="2.5" fill="#ffd700"/>

  <!-- flag on top -->
  <line x1="50" y1="17" x2="50" y2="8" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="50,8 62,11 50,14" fill="#ff4444"/>

  <!-- window patch left -->
  <rect x="26" y="55" width="8" height="8" rx="1" fill="#7ab8d4" transform="rotate(-8 30 59)"/>
  <rect x="27" y="56" width="6" height="6" rx="0.5" fill="#a8d8ea" transform="rotate(-8 30 59)"/>

  <!-- window patch right -->
  <polygon points="66,52 74,52 73,60 65,60" fill="#7ab8d4"/>
  <polygon points="67,53 73,53 72,59 66,59" fill="#a8d8ea"/>

  <!-- door flap left -->
  <polygon points="40,78 42,55 50,42 50,78" fill="#f0d060" opacity="0.85"/>
  <!-- door flap right -->
  <polygon points="60,78 58,55 50,42 50,78" fill="#e8c547" opacity="0.85"/>

  <!-- small lantern hanging -->
  <line x1="50" y1="42" x2="50" y2="48" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="4" fill="#ffdd44"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#fff8b0"/>

  <!-- small camp items near tent -->
  <!-- small rock left -->
  <ellipse cx="12" cy="82" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#7f8c8d"/>
  <ellipse cx="12" cy="81" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#95a5a6"/>

  <!-- small rock right -->
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="83" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#7f8c8d"/>
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="82" rx="3" ry="1.8" fill="#95a5a6"/>

  <!-- tiny shrub left -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="85" r="4" fill="#2e8b57"/>
  <circle cx="17" cy="84" r="3" fill="#3cb371"/>
  <circle cx="23" cy="84" r="3" fill="#3cb371"/>
</svg>
